example.title: The NT hash of Password, the specification's example
example.note: The spec's example password Password gives a digest starting a4f49c40. The NT hash is the MD4 of the text as UTF-16LE: 16 bytes.

name: digest: password (well-known NT hash)
ref: Microsoft MS-NLMP 3.3.1 (NTOWFv1: MD4 of UTF-16LE) and 4.2.2 (Password); NT hash of password is widely published

example.title: Lower case gives a different NT hash
example.note: password gives a digest starting 8846f7ea, not the value of Password. The NT hash is case-sensitive, unlike the LM hash.

name: digest: empty password (MD4 of empty)
ref: MS-NLMP 3.3.1: MD4 of the empty string (RFC 1320 A.5)
